text: SICAM T is a digital transducer that precisely measures electrical quantities in your network. Use this single unit for comprehensive monitoring.
heading: Why SICAM T transducer?

text: Accurate, timely electrical network data is crucial for effective control and operational awareness. SICAM T provides up to 60 measured values for precise control, immediate notifications and clear visualization. The compact design allows for flexible application in industrial and utility environments.
heading: Why SICAM T transducer?

text: Enable reliable control and rapid response to critical events with 4 fast analog outputs and 2 binary outputs to minimize downtime. Simplify operation with a user-friendly web server, eliminating extra software and making setup straightforward.
heading: Why SICAM T transducer?

text: Precisely monitor electrical networks with the SICAM T digital transducer. Access up to 60 measured values for comprehensive insights and informed decision-making in your industrial applications.
heading: Improve network monitoring

text: Use fast analog and binary outputs for reliable automation. Integrate with substation automation, protection or SCADA via protocols. React quickly to operational changes for system stability.
heading: Automate processes

text: Deploy a transducer to operate reliably in extreme temperatures with high EMC immunity. Minimize downtime and reduce maintenance for sustained performance.
heading: Keep operations running

text: Create a common time basis when communicating: external time synchronization via Ethernet NTP or via field bus using the MODBUS RTU or the IEC 60870-5-103 communication protocol. Internal time synchronization via RTC.
heading: Time synchronization

text: 4 inputs for alternating voltage measurement and 3 inputs for alternating current measurements up to 10 A continuous. 4 optional DC analog outputs freely configurable and individually programmable binary outputs.
